data.introduction: Fresh out of college, Hannah Marshall covers her mom's night shift at a hotel, where she crosses paths with Miguel Elsher, who has been drugged. As fate would have it, she ends up spending a night in bed with him. Later, when Hannah applies for a position at Elsher Corporation, she becomes Miguel's assistant.As they spend more time together, a gradual romance blossoms between Miguel and Hannah.

Forced into marriage, Noelle reluctantly endures a series of blind dates until she meets Sebastian, a charming yet seemingly ordinary man. Enchanted by his allure, she marries him, anticipating a simple life. However, she soon discovers that Sebastian is not as he seems. Unveiling Sebastian's true identity as a billionaire, secrets begin to unravel, thrusting Noelle into an unexpected situation as she gradually uncovers the truth about his past...

After discovering her boyfriend's betrayal, Alison fakes amnesia for revenge—never expecting to fall for Carl, the man she's forced to pretend to be her boyfriend. As passion ignites between them, her vindictive best friend spirals into violent jealousy, threatening everything with deadly consequences in this twisted game of hearts and lies.

Rebelling against her perfect life, high school senior cheerleader Brooke falls into a hot and heavy romance with transfer student and new QB Nate. Everything seems perfect. Until she discovers that Nate has a very dark side.

After signing the divorce agreement, Stella determined to break free from the past. However, she met Dereck at a bar, a handsome and mysterious man whose appearance injected new sparks into the story. Dereck timely helped Stella out of trouble, and the relationship between the two began to heat up.

Andrea Griffin accidentally ran into Zach Andrews's hotel room while escaping from danger. The two spent a night blinded by passion together, waking up the next morning with mixed emotions. Andrea fled the hotel the next morning after leaving half of the room's fees on the nightstand to attend a speed dating event. Motivated by his mother's nagging for him to find a wife, Zach attended the event himself.
A beauty content creator from 2024 traveled back to the 1990s and encountered the younger version of a future billionaire. The story unfolds as they navigate a romantic relationship.

To pay her father's medical bills, Rosie marries Mason in place of her runaway twin sister for a three-year contract. Just as her devotion finally wins his affection, his first love returns, shattering her world. Enduring neglect and heartbreak, Rosie leaves him without looking back the moment the three years are up. By the time Mason learns the truth and regrets his actions, she is already gone.

Daisy, a wealthy family's illegitimate daughter, was forced to marry the racing driver, the notorious playboy Logan (a rich second-gen) for her sister Emily to cover their mother's medical bills. Logan, a hormone-fueled man, was a terrible husband—absent from the wedding, detached, and hating Daisy.The two compete with each other, treating marriage as a war, and want to conquer each other. Later, Logan discovered his long-sought savior was his despised wife...

Riley Irwin, a fishmonger, enters a contract marriage with Joel Nolan, winning his trust and favor through flattery. However, after they confess their love, she regains the lost memories of her true identity, and forgets everything about Joel—and so, he embarks on a long and difficult journey to win her heart once again.

Rachel Cooper undergoes a risky heart surgery so she can bear a child for her husband, Kyle Zeller. She is unaware that he has been cheating on her with an anesthesiology intern, Quinn Shaw. During the surgery, Quinn deliberately administers the wrong anesthesia, and Kyle chooses not to intervene. At this critical moment, Anton Hall—Rachel’s ex and a heart surgeon—returns to rescue her. Can he make it in time?

After losing her farm due to a sexist will clause, 50-something farmer Teresa marries "farmhand" Augustus in a flash to retain her land—unaware he's a wealthy CEO hiding his identity. Their lies unravel amid ex-wives' sabotage, a long-lost daughter's return, and deadly threats, yet they discover true love that bridges their worlds, fighting to rebuild both the farm and their unexpected bond.
